feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 18 November 2026 8:40am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 18 November 2026 at 8:40am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong Winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the west of Ireland, with another in the North Sea, bringing complex frontal zones across the British Isles.


##Wind##

East or northeasterly 4 or 5 in the north and east of the area, occasionally 6 towards the North Channel, but west or southwesterly 2 to 4 in the south and west of the area. Becoming mainly variable 2 to 4 in all waters for a time this evening, then gradually settling east or northeast 4 to 6 overnight and tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Occasional rain.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or possibly poor in rain at times.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or northeast 4 to 6, decreasing 5 or 6 overnight into Friday.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Occasional rain, becoming mainly fair tomorrow afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain at first.
